arguments.text: Good start. Settle now, long smooth strokes, find race rhythm.

Fastest 8000 m: 6.4 out-and-back legs of 1250 m, about 45 min. Settle from the hard start to ~155-160 W pod (pre-race CP 154 W pod / 13.3 kJ; may be 10-25% off). TEST CP with heart rate in minutes 4-14: HR model says 151 bpm at CP, creep 4 bpm per 10 min, lag 30 s; at a steady effort a level HR = below CP, HR climbing faster than creep = above CP. Then set critical_power_pod_w belief. Hold even effort (slightly more into the current), spend reserve so it empties at the line: finish sprint from ~600-800 m to go. Watch for incidents: weed (GPS speed drops vs pod power on both directions) -> clear_rudder; pod drift (pod power vs HR mismatch) -> pod_gain belief; radio course change -> set_race_distance + tell.

t=61s: start 209 W pod, HR 151. Cued ease with pace 164 s/500 (aim ~158 W pod). Pre-race 12-min piece faded at min 11-12 (160,136 W) with HR flat 171-172 from min 3: test HR max ~172. HR model: 151 at CP(154), 142 at 90%, 132 at 80%; creep 4 bpm/10 min.

Started HR test piece at ~244 s: -12% for 300 s (~152 W pod). Read HR trend 300-545 s: falling to ~152 and levelling = CP >= 152; still climbing = CP < 152.
